$description: Stellar UI tokens for desktop web pages. The source of truth: stellar.css and the guides follow these values. Colours are sRGB hex; sizes are CSS px. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x, worked out in references/tokens.md.

theme.$description: The two theme colours, a complementary pair. Fixed for every product; variants never change them. Share of a page: neutrals carry it, orbit about a tenth, flare only in touches. The two meet only at a focus: never side by side in equal amounts, never as two thin lines touching.

orbit.$description: BRAND AND STRUCTURE: the wordmark's hollow line, large type and big-figure accents, the // section mark, panel tabs, orbit and star-chart lines, the main chart colour, link underlines, the command-bar seal; and WHERE YOU ARE (current page, section, item, selected filter, a switch that is on, progress, the row the pointer is on). Lines, bars, brackets, large type (>= 24px, or >= 18.66px bold). A showcase page may have one whole violet block. Never the ground under small text.

flare.$description: ENERGY AND HIGHLIGHT: the main action (flare at rest), the wipe on a button being pointed at, best and record figures, figures and states that need a look, the notice flag, the highlighter, the glint of a star. Light theme: fill only, ink text on it. Dark theme: may also be lines and text (16.30:1 on dark paper).

onOrbit.$description: text on an orbit fill: large or bold only (4.03:1). Flare text on orbit is 3.49:1: large bold only as well.

share.$description: about how much of a page is orbit; flare is a few small touches; the rest is neutral. The one violet block on a showcase page is the exception.

paper.$description: page background: a cool lavender-grey, so white sheets lift off it

ink.$description: text and every line that carries meaning: a night-sky violet black

chip.$description: quiet fills: idle buttons, chips, tracks, skeletons

wash.$description: the block under a current item: orbit 14% over panel, with an orbit bar and ink text

dark.$description: A second complete theme, not an inversion: a night sky with lifted panels. The theme colours stay the same.

commandBar.$description: the console's command bar and the toast are dark in both themes

commandBarWash.$description: orbit 30% over the command bar: the current section

spectrumB.$description: spectrum strip: starlight cyan. Used nowhere else

hatch.$description: ink opacity of the 45° hatch lines (geometry: size.hatch)

starsLine.$description: orbit opacity of the starfield's chart lines (the SVGs carry their own lighter strokes inside)

starsGlint.$description: the starfield's four-point stars: ink on light, flare on dark

markLight.$description: flare opacity of the highlighter and text selection, light theme

ui.$description: Interface: a wide geometric Latin face for labels and figures (Saira, variable wdth 50-125 / wght 100-900) with a plain Chinese sans.

text.$description: Reading: the same Chinese sans, regular weight, generous leading.

display.$description: wordmark: CSS clamp(3rem, 10vw, 11rem); the hollow second line is 0.48 of it

eyebrow.$description: wide upper-case label; letterSpacing in em

measure.$description: a reading line, about 38 Chinese characters

small.$description: pressable things: tags, chips, nav items. Bottom-right corner

panel.$description: the cutaway a console panel turns towards the star dial (layout, not a press cue)

radius.$description: no rounded corners, except things that are round anyway (the dial, gauges, planets)

line.$description: star: the four-point star at the end of a lead or title line, px across

star.$description: Every star is a four-point star: tips on the axes, sides curving in to a waist (a share of the tip, on the diagonal). Starfield classes use waist 0.44 (faintest) to 0.30 (brightest). CSS: --st-star; script: assets/stars/draw-stars.mjs star().

hatch.$description: 45° lines rising to the right (/). CSS: repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent 0 5px, ink22% 5px 6.5px).

target.$description: smallest click target for a pointer (WCAG 2.5.8 asks 24; 32 keeps rows and buttons comfortable)

minWidth.$description: the narrowest desktop window the templates are checked at

snap.$description: arrives fast, settles: rows stepping in, items appearing, FLIP catch-up

mech.$description: starts slow, stops hard: shutters, wipes, fills, tabs extending, drawers, and every exit

ease.$description: plain transitions: the spectrum sweep, colour changes

duration.$description: ms. Answers to an action: 100-400. One entrance piece on page open: <= 650. A whole entrance sequence: <= sequenceMax. Exits: about 0.6-0.7 of the entrance, always mech.

delay.$description: ms before the first item of a group starts

stagger.$description: ms between items of one group. Only these steps; with many items shrink the stagger, never the sequenceMax.

motion.$description: Every motion answers an action or a change of state; nothing loops for decoration (the ticker and unknown-progress bar are the only loops; the starfield never moves); everything switches off under prefers-reduced-motion. See references/motion.md.

variant.$description: Per-product variants: the rules and both theme colours stay, these change the face. See references/variation.md. Web: data-st-* on <html>, or assets/variant.js.

paper.$description: Shifts paper, panel, rule and chip only; ink, ink2 and the theme colours stay, and every text pair keeps >= 5.3:1 (references/tokens.md).

ground.$description: What lies faintly under the page: starfield patches, concentric chart arcs, hatch, nothing.

density.$description: Scales type and spacing together; click targets stay at their minimum.

motion.$description: calm drops page entrances; responses and in/out stay.
